item.title: [Bug]: Window Hopper: Alt + ` hotkey fails to trigger, but works fine in Command Palette
item.author: cmixed

attachments_analyzed.public_summary: Downloaded for triage; AltWindowCycle settings show alt=true code=192 and module log only initializes, with no hotkey callback/failure line.

judgment.rationale: The reproduction isolates Window Hopper: Alt+VK_OEM_3 is configured and enabled, but the global hotkey does not trigger while the same chord is accepted by Command Palette and Win+` works for Window Hopper.
evidence: Issue steps reproduce on zh_CN Windows 11 25H2 with multiple IMEs and elevated PowerToys.
Diagnostic settings show AltWindowCycle enabled with next_window_shortcut alt=true code=192.
origin/main defaults Window Hopper to VK_OEM_3 and dispatches only after runner global-hotkey callback; module log only initialized.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a Window Hopper hotkey registration/diagnostic fix focused on OEM/backtick keys under non-US layouts and registration conflicts.

fix_assessment.rationale: The code path is narrow, but the exact failure branch needs instrumented registration evidence.

proposed_fixes.title: Normalize and diagnose Window Hopper backtick hotkey registration
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Window Hopper defaults to VK_OEM_3 for backtick and relies on the runner global hotkey table; on the reporter system the module never receives Alt+VK_OEM_3 even though local Command Palette input recognizes the chord.
plan: Log AltWindowCycle hotkey registration success/failure and normalized VK/modifiers.
Audit ShortcutControl serialization for OEM keys so display text and stored VK match RegisterHotKey input.
If VK_OEM_3 is unreliable across layouts/IMEs, show conflict/remap guidance or migrate the default.
Add regression tests for Alt+VK_OEM_3 settings serialization and registration diagnostics.
verification: On zh_CN and US layouts, Alt+backtick opens Window Hopper and logs CycleWindow.

confidence.rationale: Diagnostics prove the configured shortcut and symptom; registration-vs-layout branch remains unknown.

issue_context.summary: Window Hopper does not receive its default Alt+backtick global hotkey on a zh_CN Insider system, while Command Palette accepts the chord and an alternate Window Hopper shortcut works.
known_information: PowerToys v0.101.2432 preview, GitHub install, Windows 11 25H2 26200.9278, zh_CN, admin.
Reporter tested Pinyin, WeChat IME, and US keyboard.
Diagnostic settings record AltWindowCycle code 192 with alt=true.
inferences: The failure likely happens before AltWindowCycle::on_hotkey: registration, conflict handling, or OEM-key normalization.
issue_context.analysis: Command Palette handles local input, but Window Hopper needs global registration; the default is a layout-sensitive OEM VK.

information_gaps.information: RegisterHotKey/runner conflict result for Alt+VK_OEM_3 on the affected machine.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines registration-conflict vs layout/OEM-key serialization fix.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reproduce with logging or add /bugreport after toggling Window Hopper and pressing Alt+backtick.

design.root_cause: Global hotkey callback is not reached for Alt+VK_OEM_3 on the affected layout/system.
evidence: Configured code 192 and module init-only log.

affected_files.purpose: Window Hopper default hotkeys and callbacks

implementation_steps.current_behavior: No visible registration failure in diagnostic output.
implementation_steps.change: Log module key, modifiers, VK code, and GetLastError for registration failure/conflict.
edge_cases: Do not log typed input or window titles.

implementation_steps.change: Validate/register OEM shortcut consistently or surface remap guidance when unsupported.
implementation_steps.code_block: if (hotkey.key == VK_OEM_3 && registrationFailed) report shortcut conflict with remap guidance;
edge_cases: Keyboard layouts map OEM keys differently.

risks: Changing default shortcut can surprise users.
alternatives: Tell users to remap only, rejected because default should work or report a conflict.

actions.label: Request Window Hopper hotkey registration trace

comment.body: The report confirms Window Hopper is enabled and configured for Alt+` (`code: 192`), but the module log only initializes. Please provide a fresh `/bugreport` immediately after toggling Window Hopper off/on and pressing Alt+` once, or test an instrumented build that logs global hotkey registration. We need the RegisterHotKey/conflict result for Alt+VK_OEM_3.
